findings.claim: FY2025 10-K names two customers each at/above 10% of modules business net sales: Silicon Ranch Corporation and NextEra Energy.
findings.excerpt: During 2025, Silicon Ranch Corporation and NextEra Energy each accounted for 10% or more of our modules business net sales.

findings.claim: For FY2024, no single customer accounted for 10% or more of First Solar's net sales (an improvement in diversification versus 2023 and 2021).
findings.source: First Solar, Inc. Form 10-K FY2024 (aggregated search summary, not independently page-verified)

findings.claim: Historical concentration was higher in earlier years: FY2023 Customer #1 = 10%; FY2022 three customers each >=10% (14%, 10%, 10%); FY2021 Customer #1 = 12%, Customer #2 = 10%. Customers are not named in these older filings, only numbered.
findings.source: First Solar, Inc. Form 10-K FY2021/2022/2023 (aggregated search summary, not independently page-verified)

findings.claim: 2026 US solar bankruptcy wave (100+ companies since 2023, including Freedom Forever Chapter 11 on 2026-04-15) is concentrated in residential/C&I installers; commentary frames First Solar as insulated because it sells utility-scale modules to large developers/utilities rather than to homeowners.
findings.source: Yahoo Finance / TheStreet: "One company stands to gain as bankruptcy wave hits solar sector"
findings.excerpt: Unlike residential solar installers, First Solar does not sell to homeowners and builds large volumes of panels for utility-scale power plants, the kind that feed electricity to the grid.

customer_concentration_credit.note: No direct credit-rating or balance-sheet-stress data found specifically for Silicon Ranch Corporation or NextEra Energy within the 4-query budget; concentration figures for FY2021-2023 came from an aggregated search summary rather than a single page fetch, so treated as lower-confidence (excerpt=null, snippet-sourced). One WebFetch used on the FY2025 10-K to confirm named customers.
